vv63:1.1: Daḷhadhammā nisārassa dhanuṃ olubbha tiṭṭhasi khattiyo nu 'si rājañño ādu luddo vane caro ti. || ||
vv63:2.1: Assakādhipatissāhaṃ bhante putto vane caro nāmaṃ me bhikkhu te brūmi Sujāto iti maṃ vidū. || ||
vv63:3.1: Mige gavesamāno 'haṃ ogāhanto brahāvanaṃ migaṃ tañ c' eva nāddakkhiṃ tañ ca disvā ṭhito ahan ti. || ||
vv63:4.1: Svāgataṃ te mahāpuñña atho te adurāgataṃ etto udakam ādāya pāde pakkhālayassu te. || ||
vv63:5.1: Idam pi pāniyaṃ sītaṃ ābhataṃ girigabbharā rājaputta tato pītvā santhatasmiṃ upāvisā ti. || ||
vv63:6.1: Kalyāṇī vata te vācā savaṇīyā mahāmuni nelā atthavatī vaggu mantā atthañ ca bhāsasi. || ||
vv63:7.1: Kā te rati vane viharato isinisabha vadehi puṭṭho tava vacanapathaṃ nisāmayitvā atthadhammapadaṃ samācaremase ti. || ||
vv63:8.1: Ahiṃsā sabbapāṇīnaṃ kumār' amhāka ruccati theyyā ca aticārā ca majjapānā ca ārati, || ||
vv63:9.1: Ārati samacariyā ca bāhusaccaṃ kataññutā diṭṭh' eva dhamme pāsaṃsā dhammā ete pasaṃsiyā ti. || ||
vv63:10.1: Santike maraṇaṃ tuyhaṃ oraṃ māsehi pañcahi rājaputta vijānāhi attānaṃ parimocayā ti. || ||
vv63:11.1: Katamaṃ svāhaṃ janapadaṃ gantvā kiṃ kammaṃ kiñ ca porisaṃ kāya vā pana vijjāya bhaveyyaṃ ajarāmaro ti. || ||
vv63:12.1: Na vijjate so padeso kammaṃ vijjā ca porisaṃ yattha gantvā bhave macco rājaputtājarāmaro. || ||
vv63:13.1: Mahaddhanā mahābhogā raṭṭhavanto pi khattiyā pahūtadhanadhaññāse te pi na ajarāmarā. || ||
vv63:14.1: Yadi te sutā Andhakaveṇhuputtā sūrā vīrā vikkantappahārino te pi āyukkhayaṃ pattā viddhastā sassatī samā. || ||
vv63:15.1: Khattiyā brāhmaṇā vessā suddā caṇḍālapukkusā ete c' aññe ca jātiyā te pi na ajarāmarā. || ||
vv63:16.1: Ye mantaṃ parivattenti chaḷaṅgaṃ brahmacintitaṃ ete c' aññe ca vijjāya te pi no ajarāmarā. || ||
vv63:17.1: Isayo cāpi ye santā saññatattā tapassino sarīraṃ te pi kālena vijahanti tapassino. || ||
vv63:18.1: Bhāvitattā pi arahanto katakiccā anāsavā nikkhipanti imaṃ dehaṃ puññapāpaparikkhayā ti. || ||
vv63:19.1: Subhāsitā atthavatī gāthāyo te mahāmuni nijjhatto 'mhi subhaṭṭhena tvañ ca me saraṇaṃ bhavā ti. || ||
vv63:20.1: Mā maṃ tvaṃ saraṇaṃ gaccha tam eva saraṇaṃ vaja Sakyaputtaṃ mahāvīraṃ yam ahaṃ saraṇaṃ gato ti. || ||
vv63:21.1: Katarasmiṃ so janapade satthā tumhāka mārisa aham pi daṭṭhuṃ gacchissaṃ jinaṃ appaṭipuggalan ti. || ||
vv63:22.1: Puratthimasmiṃ janapade Okkākakulasambhavo satthāsi purisājañño so ca kho parinibbuto ti. || ||
vv63:23.1: Sace hi buddho tiṭṭheyya satthā tumhāka mārisa yojanāni sahassāni gaccheyyaṃ payirupāsituṃ. || ||
vv63:24.1: Yato ca kho {parinibbuto} satthā tumhāka mārisa nibbutam pi mahāvīraṃ gacchāmi saraṇaṃ ahaṃ. || ||
vv63:25.1: Upemi saraṇaṃ buddhaṃ dhammañ cāpi anuttaraṃ saṅghañ ca naradevassa gacchāmi saraṇaṃ ahaṃ. || ||
vv63:26.1: Pāṇātipātā viramāmi khippaṃ loke adinnaṃ parivajjayāmi amajjapo no ca musā bhaṇāmi sakena dārena ca homi tuṭṭho ti. || ||
vv63:27.1: Sahassaraṃsīva yathā mahappabho disaṃ yathā bhāti nabhe anukkamaṃ tathappakāro tav' ayaṃ mahāratho samantato yojanasatta-m-āyato. || ||
vv63:28.1: Suvaṇṇapaṭṭehi samantam otthaṭo ur' assa muttāhi maṇīhi cittito lekhā suvaṇṇassa ca rūpiyassa ca sobhanti veḷuriyamayā sunimmitā. || ||
vv63:29.1: Sīsañ c' idaṃ veḷuriyassa nimmitaṃ yugañ c' idaṃ lohitakāya cittitaṃ yuttā suvaṇṇassa ca rūpiyassa ca sobhanti assā ca p' ime manojavā. || ||
vv63:30.1: So tiṭṭhasi hemarathe adhiṭṭhito devānam indo va sahassavāhano pucchāmi tāhaṃ yasavanta kovidaṃ kathaṃ tayā laddho ayaṃ uḷāro ti. || ||
vv63:31.1: Sujāto nām' ahaṃ bhante rājaputto pure ahuṃ tvañ ca maṃ anukampāya saññamasmiṃ nivesayi. || ||
vv63:32.1: Khīṇāyukañ ca maṃ ñatvā sarīraṃ pādāsi satthuno: imaṃ Sujāta pūjehi taṃ te atthāya hehiti. || ||
vv63:33.1: Tāhaṃ gandhehi mālehi pūjayitvā samuyyuto pahāya mānusaṃ dehaṃ upapanno 'mhi Nandanaṃ. || ||
vv63:34.1: Nandanopavane ramme nānādijagaṇāyute ramāmi naccagītehi accharāhi purakkhato ti. || ||
